Total Serialism

98 interactive algorithmic art generators optimized for pen plotting. Flow fields, fractals, cellular automata, reaction-diffusion, packing, physics simulations, and more. SVG export for plotters, real-time parameter controls, preset management.

Tartanism

Generate mathematically valid Scottish tartans. Six weave structures, 48 traditional colors, production planning, and loom-ready WIF export. Explore the line between tartan and plaid.

Mastra Dashboard

Pen Plotter Pipeline

Generative SVG art pipeline with AI scoring. 40 procedural factories producing work across moire interference, op-art, voxel sculpture, halftone, pointillism, circle packing, hatching, ridgelines, calligraphic gestures, and more.

Pen Plotter Autoresearch

An editorial field journal for an autonomous loop running on 40 generative art factories. 41,572 specimens, scored by six algorithmic signals and five vision-language judges. Set in Boska, printed on aged paper.
